title: Log categories you can switch
description:
Turn logging on and off per category while the program runs.

```
log render: off, ai: on
[ai] picked target
toggle render
[render] frame 10 drawn
```
hints: `g_on[category]` is `false` for a new category, which is the default you want (lesson 8.03).
Keep logging cheap when off: check the flag before building the text.
requirements: A `std::map<std::string, bool>` of categories, all off by default except `error`.
`log(category, text)` prints only when its category is on.
A `toggle(category)` function, as a debug console command would call.
stretch: Save which categories are on in a settings file.
